title: BREATHE · 07 · Tres Tres Seis · 336
style: warm acoustic guitar, soft pad, 60 BPM, two narrators ES female and EN male, calm breathing tempo, gentle, no drums, no edm, no auto-tune, soft outdoor ambience
lyrics:
[Intro — soft, slow]
Inhala… exhala…
Breathe in… breathe out…
Uno, dos, tres tres seis.
One, two, three three six.

[Verse 1 — ES female, calm]
Respira lento, corazón tranquilo,
breathe slow, heart at ease,
cuenta conmigo, cuenta hasta seis,
count with me, count to six.

[Verse 2 — EN male, warm]
In through the nose, out through the mouth,
por la nariz, por la boca,
shoulders drop, jaw lets go,
hombros bajan, mandíbula suelta.

[Chorus — both]
Tres tres seis,
three three six,
un ritmo seguro,
a steady beat,
mi casa es su casa,
my house is your house,
aquí respiramos,
here we breathe.

[Verse 3 — ES female]
Si el día pesa, suelta el peso,
if the day is heavy, drop the weight,
una respiración, una promesa,
one breath, one promise.

[Bridge — EN male soft]
Nothing to fix right now,
nada que arreglar ahora,
just this breath,
solo este aliento,
just this room,
solo este cuarto.

[Outro — both, fading]
Inhala… exhala…
breathe in… breathe out…
tres tres seis.
three three six.
Aquí estás. You are here.
